text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
We were supposed to go to karaoke 
together, but... it looks like we'd better 
pass on that...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
This much is totally no problem! After 
all, Dober invited me, so let's just go, 
go, go!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"Still, with rain like this, an umbrella 
won't stop you from getting soaked, so—"

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
I-I-It... It came out, it came out, it 
came out! According to my sunfish strap 
fortune telling... shouting in the rain 
brings great fortune!!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
This is truly a sign that we should go to 
karaoke today as planned! An extra-large 
serving of good luck is guaranteed~!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Oh, lucky chance, with his blessing! Here 
we go♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
B-Both of you?! You're gonna catch a cold! 
Wait up!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Right, let's at least wait and see if the 
rain lets up a bit—

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
"Suzuka, Dober, come ooon! If we all run 
our hardest through the rain, I'm sure 
we'll see a wonderful view!"

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: ...I wonder if that's just how it is?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"H-Hey?! Isn't that way too fast to 
flip-flop?!"

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Hey hey, Dober, you come on too♪ Full-on 
sprint to the karaoke box, and let's sing 
the night away till the rain stops♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I'll at least bring towels over for now! 
Wait right there, everyone!
